column8: Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts → Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data → Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr → Bool
Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data → Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawRef → Option ℤ
String → String → Prop := fun path key => ∃ c rest, key.toList = path.toList ++ c :: rest ∧ (c = '.' ∨ c = '@')

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → ∀ (law : Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr), law.fieldsPlain = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.compile law) before after = Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote facts old new law
∀ (n name key : String), '.' ∉ name.toList → '@' ∉ name.toList → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.Extends ("state/" ++ n) key → key ≠ "state/" ++ name
∀ (path label key sep : String), sep = "." ∨ sep = "@" → key = path ++ sep ++ label ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.Extends (path ++ sep ++ label) key → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.Extends path key

∀ key ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.factKeys, key.toList.head? ≠ Option.some 's'
∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (name : String), { slots := facts.slots }.get ("state/" ++ name) = Option.none
∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts), ∀ p ∈ facts.slots, p.1 ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.factKeys
String → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data → Option ℤ

∀ (name : String), '.' ∉ name.toList → '@' ∉ name.toList → ∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots.fieldSlotsTop fields = Option.some slots → { slots := slots }.get ("state/" ++ name) = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.firstScalarField name fields

∀ (path : String) (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.fieldSlots path fields = Option.some slots → ∀ p ∈ slots, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.Extends path p.1
∀ (n name : String), "state/" ++ n = "state/" ++ name → n = name
String → List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) → Option ℤ
∀ (front back : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)) (key : Minidregg.Pred.Slot), { slots := front ++ back }.get key = ({ slots := front }.get key).or ({ slots := back }.get key)
∀ (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)) (key : Minidregg.Pred.Slot), (∀ p ∈ slots, p.1 ≠ key) → { slots := slots }.get key = Option.none
∀ (key : String), key.toList.head? ≠ Option.some 's' → ∀ (rest : List Char), key.toList ≠ "state".toList ++ rest

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots new = Option.some slots → ∀ (ref : Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawRef), ref.plain = Bool.true → { slots := facts.slots ++ slots }.get ref.slot = Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawRef.read facts new ref
∀ (name : String), Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.plainName name = Bool.true → '.' ∉ name.toList ∧ '@' ∉ name.toList

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (oldSlots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), (∀ (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), old = Option.some value → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots value = Option.some oldSlots) → (old = Option.none → oldSlots = []) → ∀ (name : String), Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.plainName name = Bool.true → { slots := facts.slots ++ oldSlots }.get ("state/" ++ name) = old.bind (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.fieldOf name)

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → ∀ (laws : List (String × Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr)), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.packageLaw laws) before after = Bool.true → ∀ law ∈ laws, Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote facts old new law.2 = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitWrite record facts old new = Except.ok () → ∀ law ∈ record.packageLaws, Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote facts old new law.2 = Bool.true

∀ (record : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.ObjectRecord) (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (seed : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.admitSeed record facts seed = Except.ok () → ∀ law ∈ record.packageLaws, Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote facts Option.none seed law.2 = Bool.true
Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data → Option ℤ

∀ (path : String) (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.slotsOf path value = Option.some slots → ∀ p ∈ slots, p.1 = path ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.scalarOf value = Option.some p.2 ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.Extends path p.1

∀ (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots value = Option.some slots → ∀ (name : String), '.' ∉ name.toList → '@' ∉ name.toList → { slots := slots }.get ("state/" ++ name) = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.fieldOf name value

∀ (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots value = Option.some slots → ∀ (key : String), key.toList.head? ≠ Option.some 's' → { slots := slots }.get key = Option.none

∀ (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (slots : List (Minidregg.Pred.Slot × ℤ)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots value = Option.some slots → ∀ p ∈ slots, ∃ rest, String.toList p.1 = "state".toList ++ rest
state/.toList = "state".toList ++ ['/']

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyLaw.fieldsPlain = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts (Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 5)) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 7) Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyLaw = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts (Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 7)) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 5) Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyLaw = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.ObjectiveBendLaw.LawExpr.denote Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts (Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 5)) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 1001) Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyLaw = Bool.false

Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts (Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 5)) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tally 7) = Option.some ({ slots := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts.slots ++ [("state/total", 5)] }, { slots := Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectLaw.tallyFacts.slots ++ [("state/total", 7)] })

∀ (facts : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.Facts) (old : Option Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (new : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data) (before after : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.views facts old new = Option.some (before, after) → ∃ oldSlots newSlots, before = { slots := facts.slots ++ oldSlots } ∧ after = { slots := facts.slots ++ newSlots } ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots new = Option.some newSlots ∧ (∀ (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), old = Option.some value → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectRecord.stateSlots value = Option.some oldSlots) ∧ (old = Option.none → oldSlots = [])
